key_insight: TPPO replaces a single critic with a cumulative, log-odds-style value decomposition that better tracks how value evolves across a reasoning trajectory under sparse terminal rewards.
engineering_relevance: This gives a more faithful reward/advantage signal for training language models on math reasoning, improving PPO stability and generalization without changing the underlying task reward.
method: Decompose successive prefix values with a Bayesian additive update in log-odds space.
Parameterize the value as a sum of position-wise scalar outputs, producing cumulative value logits.
Train these outputs using terminal-outcome supervision on reconstructed values.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports +7.0 and +8.4 aggregate math-score gains over PPO on Qwen3-4B-Base and Qwen3-8B-Base, plus improved out-of-distribution generalization across several model sizes and additional tasks.
watch_item: Because the method reconstructs values from position-wise outputs, implementation quality and calibration of the cumulative value logits may strongly affect stability under sparse-reward training.
paper_title: TPPO: Tracking-Value PPO For Language Model Reasoning
